Class Game

java.lang.Object
helloworld.helloworld.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
Resizable, Serializable
public class Game extends Object implements Resizable, Serializable
Represents the full state of the ping pong game. It stores the players, the ball, window dimensions, scoring target, pause state, winner information and temporary messages shown during gameplay.
Author:
Rama Houreh
